changes: Compose the existing per-run diagnosis score with candidate-specific CSV truth checks for baseline, current, delta, and registered components.
Require candidate metric, scope fingerprint, exact period, method, evidence type, unit, citation, and completed validated action binding.
Record expected numeric result, full task acceptance, partial status, and execution errors separately; partial output cannot pass complete-task acceptance.

For full arm, require all three optional Critic outputs, three successful critic-node extract logical calls with attempt IDs, passed verdicts, and final approval; for off arm, require explicit evaluation_ablation and zero critic-node optional Critic calls.
Statistical contribution is checked as a descriptive numerical result; business-causality proof is not required.
Require the current deterministic causal-language review to be approved; this is a no-unsupported-causal-claim boundary, not a requirement to prove causality.
Retain root-cause-run-v2 output alongside new checks; no change to existing Golden or global scoring semantics.
Unknown Token usage remains null according to the base scorer; budget exhaustion never becomes an expected safe stop for these success tasks.
tolerance_source: Per-candidate absolute tolerance copied from the reviewed candidate/truth artifacts; defaults are not substituted when a case has no tolerance.
denominator: One per case × arm × replicate; planned candidate protocol is 17 × 2 × 3 = 102 runs.

off: evaluation_ablation for all three; zero critic-node optional LLM calls
